Delivered earlier then expected. The hair was a little thin when parted but it's served its purpose

reviews.t: As soon as you add water, it goes straight
reviews.x: I bought two of these for my little girls who love to do hair. I thought this would be perfect because it has the same texture hair that they have. However, as soon as they wet this hair it got silky straight and has never gone back to the "afro" style. :(

reviews.t: The description of the product is misleading.
reviews.x: I am very disappointed with this product. This mannequin is not a true reflection of the description. I purchased this for my daughter who is a cosmetology student, she tried to use a heating tool on this mannequin and the hair melted. The description states you can apply heat and chemicals. Currently she is only able to use the mannequin for hair cuts.
Not curly! After washing the hair it has more of a wave pattern not kinky curly. Doesn't shed to bad though

reviews.t: This product is exactly what I was looking for
reviews.x: The hair on this mannequin is perfect. I purchased it for braiding and its just the right thickness and length for braids to stay put. The hair is soft but still course enough for the braids to stay pretty tight. I have not tried using a heating element on it yet but by the texture of the hair I think it will work great. The head was clean and the stand that came with it works just fine for mounting on a table or stand.
Just got it today, fast delivery ( 2 Days ). Hair is thick, soft and curly. Great for braiding!
Horrible! Hair sheds....doesn’t even clip to the table! Worst product I’ve ever gotten from Amazon. Highly disappointed
This doll is perfect. It was exactly what I expected. I will be ordering another soon!
Sheds too much! Can't even comb it without shedding.

i learned the hard way! I wash my other mannequin head all the time and the texture still remains. I’m guessing the difference here is that one is straight but anyway I thought it would be fine to treat this one the same way. I washed it and it turned straight and i thought maybe the texture will come back after a blow dry. Nope :( Now i’m left with a thick wavy texture. It’s fine just a lesson learned lol

I want to rate 2 but the hair itself isn't bad ,although it sheds like no tomorrow I found myself sweeping repetitively due to it . now when I put it in a pony tail it legit looks so thin ,its only been three days .

reviews.t: Don’t see what the fuss is about
reviews.x: I’m really not understanding why people are complaining about the shedding as if real human hair doesn’t shed from the scalp. But anyway, this is definitely worth it for practicing on relaxed type of hair. But I will say, if you wanna practice braids on a mannequin, I definitely recommend hair with a more curly, kinky texture.

[[VIDEOID:9e8890aa602fcb32c89e690723e8b941]] I gave it a 4 cause the hair does shed but to me its not much of a bother...i would definitely recommend...the hair is really soft and the parting is amazing!

reviews.t: Hair isn't really kinky, just curly but it works ...
reviews.x: Hair isn't really kinky, just curly but it works for what I need it for, practicing cornrows and box braids.
While it's packaged very nicely and the feel is good.  It's sheds quite a lot.

The product came quickly so that’s always great. It looked just like what I saw online....which is great. I needed this to practice on my braiding, and I’ve noticed the more I manipulate it the more it sheds. I’ve had to sweep twice already. However, with the price point that it’s in....I’m not mad. I have no other intentions for it. It would make a nice gift for a young girl....this would’ve helped me out a lot when I was learning to comb my hair! I would recommend and even purchase again!!!!!

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the mannequin's quality and value, calling it great for the price and worth buying.
Several reviewers find the hair well-suited for braiding, with good thickness, length, and texture.
Some reviewers report the hair sheds, and one notes it is thin or widely spaced at the scalp when parted.
A few reviewers say the hair does not hold its curly/afro texture after washing, going straight or wavy instead.
Some reviewers report heat or chemical damage and question whether it is truly 100% human hair.

qa.answer: Reviews disagree on this: one reviewer states it is not 100% human hair and appears to be a blend of human hair and fiber [5], while another treats it as real human hair that naturally sheds [6]. No review directly confirms it is 100% real human hair.
